summary: Client projectile object (class with virtual table, stored inline). Born when spells/throws were used (with ecl::projectile::Attachment/Spell/ImpactEvent, jump events). Names from Toolkit accessors of ecl::Projectile and its copy constructors EoCClient.dll+0x2951F0 / +0x295400, whose layout ends at 0x23A (padded 0x240 = registry size 576).

Thrown entity has never been activated!' and requests deletion. Same name and default (15.0) as esv::Projectile::FallbackTimer in Script Extender. | first pass: copied as 4 bytes; live 14.11/15.0 (esv::Projectile has FallbackTimer 15.0 - possibly the same).

fields.name: PathStarted
fields.evidence: ecl::Projectile::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x923540): on the first update it is 0 and is set to 1 without calling PathMover::Update; later updates advance Path. Constructor 0. | first pass: copied as a byte.

fields.name: MovingObjectActivated
fields.evidence: ecl::Projectile::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x923540): while 0 it is set to 1 once MovingObject is valid and passes FUN_1805f66e0; the path only advances when MovingObject is null or this is set (the fallback timer catches the case where it never happens). | first pass: copied as a byte (last member copied).

open_questions: Offsets come from the Toolkit (EoCClient.dll) accessors/copy ctor; the total size matches the game registry (576) and live samples fit, but no bg3.exe function was read field by field.
Path (eoc::PathMover) kept opaque as uint8_t[296]; its inner layout is SE path::PathMover.
